summary: Practise cash forecasting, budget variance analysis and month-end reporting. Explore the five-day financial management course and enrol.
lede: Financial management connects transaction records with cash oversight, budget review and useful reporting. For finance officers, accountants and operational leads, the course covers classifying cash flows, reconciling balances, reviewing working capital and explaining budget variances. Participants also practise building spreadsheet cash forecasts and documenting transaction controls using IAS 7 and COSO principles.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who handle financial records, monitor budgets or use financial reports to guide day-to-day operating decisions.
modules: Financial Records and the Accounting Cycle
prerequisites: Basic arithmetic and familiarity with routine workplace documents such as invoices or budgets will help. No accounting qualification is assumed; coding or programming is not required.
